raw:
@q query
  select ?days
  where match
    relation "produce"
    role subject "the factory in Dongguan"
    role object "units"
    role time ?days
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "be able to finish"
    role subject "the factory in Dongguan"
    role object "the Hamburg client order"
    role time "before 15 December"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@c constraint
  var ?d int
  var ?u int
  claim ?u equal 1200 times ?d
  require ?u at_least 30000
  claim ?d equal 30000 divided_by 1200
  task prove
